## Casualties over time

```{r}
library(stats19)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
casualties = get_stats19(year = 1979, type = "cas")
names(casualties)
# simplify casualty_type values:
casualties = casualties |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Cyclist") ~ "Cyclist",
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Pedestrian") ~ "Pedestrian",
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Car") ~ "Car",
    # Other:
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
casualties_per_year_type = casualties |>
  group_by(collision_year, type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
# Plot casualties over time
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = casualties_per_year_type, aes(x = collision_year, y = n, color = type)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of casualties", color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```
